name: hou_mcp_scene_reality_debug
description: Full Scene Reality Validation debug report: runs all 5 rules and logs a formatted tree report to the log panel. Shows support violations, occupancy violations, relationship failures, orphans, plausibility breakdown, and final verdicts. Canonical use: after hou_mcp_realize_layout.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.scene_validation import get_scene_reality_validator, get_validation_review

_DIV = "-" * 60

class Hou_Mcp_Scene_Reality_Debug(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_scene_reality_debug"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("scene_layout_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("environment",       "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("debug_report")
        self.add_output("geometry_valid",    "bool")
        self.add_output("semantic_valid",    "bool")
        self.add_output("plausibility_valid","bool")
        self.add_output("production_ready",  "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw = (inputs.get("scene_layout_json") or "").strip()
        env = inputs.get("environment") or "unknown"
        try:
            scene = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
        except Exception:
            self.log_error("scene_layout_json is not valid JSON.")
            return {"debug_report": "PARSE ERROR", "geometry_valid": False, "semantic_valid": False, "plausibility_valid": False, "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}
        try:
            vr  = get_scene_reality_validator().validate(scene)
            rev = get_validation_review().review(vr.to_dict())
            lines = [
                _DIV,
                f"SCENE REALITY VALIDATION: {env.upper()}",
                f"  Assets: {len(scene.get('transforms') or [])}",
                "",
                "RULE 1 — Support Surface:",
            ]
            if vr.support_violations:
                for v in vr.support_violations:
                    lines.append(f"  [BLOCKING] {v['violation_code']}: {v['detail']}")
            else:
                lines.append("  OK — all surface props are on surfaces")
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("RULE 2 — Occupancy:")
            if vr.occupancy_violations:
                for v in vr.occupancy_violations:
                    lines.append(f"  [BLOCKING] {v['violation_code']}: {v['detail']}")
            else:
                lines.append("  OK — no props inside furniture volumes")
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("RULE 3 — Relationships:")
            if vr.relationship_failures:
                for f in vr.relationship_failures:
                    lines.append(f"  [WARNING] {f['violation_code']}: {f['detail']}")
            else:
                lines.append("  OK — all relationships valid")
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("RULE 4 — Human Plausibility:")
            p = vr.plausibility
            lines.append(f"  can_sit={p.get('can_sit',1):.2f}  can_access={p.get('can_access',1):.2f}  can_reach={p.get('can_reach',1):.2f}")
            lines.append(f"  door_clear={p.get('door_clear',1):.2f}  floor_space={p.get('floor_space',1):.2f}")
            lines.append(f"  plausibility_score={vr.plausibility_score:.3f}  valid={vr.plausibility_valid}")
            if p.get('findings'):
                for f in p['findings']:
                    lines.append(f"  [INFO] {f}")
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("RULE 5 — Orphan Detection:")
            if vr.orphan_objects:
                for o in vr.orphan_objects:
                    lines.append(f"  [WARNING] {o['violation_code']}: {o['detail']}")
            else:
                lines.append("  OK — no orphaned assets")
            lines += [
                "",
                "VERDICTS:",
                f"  geometry_valid     = {vr.geometry_valid}",
                f"  semantic_valid     = {vr.semantic_valid}  (score={vr.semantic_validation_score:.3f})",
                f"  plausibility_valid = {vr.plausibility_valid}",
                f"  production_ready   = {vr.production_ready}",
                "",
                f"REVIEW: grade={rev.grade}  overall={rev.overall_score:.3f}  production_ready={rev.production_ready}",
                _DIV,
            ]
            report = "\n".join(lines)
            self.log_error(report) if not vr.production_ready else self.log_error(report)
            return {
                "debug_report":      report,
                "geometry_valid":    vr.geometry_valid,
                "semantic_valid":    vr.semantic_valid,
                "plausibility_valid":vr.plausibility_valid,
                "production_ready":  vr.production_ready,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Scene reality debug failed: {exc}")
            return {"debug_report": str(exc), "geometry_valid": False, "semantic_valid": False, "plausibility_valid": False, "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Scene_Reality_Debug
